title: Best Claude Connectors for Job Search in 2026: Find, Apply and Track
summary: Which Claude connectors actually help you find jobs and apply? Tsenta ranks 2026’s best, from Gmail and Notion to MCP servers that submit applications.
body_markdown:
**The best Claude connectors for job search in 2026 are Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify and LoopCV if you want Claude to submit applications, plus Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion and Google Drive for the email, interviews and tracking around them.** None of the four that apply is in Anthropic’s connector directory: you add each one as a custom connector by its server address, which every Claude plan allows, and Free allows one. The job connectors that are in the directory, Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob, search listings and link out, so you apply yourself.


Tsenta’s MCP server connects Claude to your Tsenta account. Claude can find roles ranked against your profile, tailor your résumé for each one and start applications that Tsenta submits on supported company career sites. Setup, example prompts and limits are on[Tsenta for Claude](https://tsenta.com/connectors/claude) .


Checked November 20, 2026, on each maker’s own pages. Tsenta publishes this ranking and sells one of the services in it. We did not run a live application benchmark across these services. The order favors documented submission first, then setup effort and how much control you keep, then the connectors that run the rest of a search.


## Can a Claude connector apply to jobs for you?


Yes, but only a custom connector to a service that submits applications. Nothing in Anthropic’s directory applies to jobs for you as of November 20, 2026: the job boards link out, and LinkedIn’s listing posts jobs for employers. Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify and LoopCV document tools that submit through their own services. JobSeek prepares form data and leaves the typing to Claude in Chrome.


Claude itself has no job application feature. On paid plans,[Claude in Chrome](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12012173-get-started-with-claude-in-chrome) and Claude Desktop’s[built-in browser](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/16607400-use-the-built-in-browser-in-claude-cowork) can click, type and fill in forms.[Anthropic’s permissions guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12902446-claude-in-chrome-permissions-guide) says that, whatever your settings, Claude may not create accounts or handle sensitive credit card or ID data, and[its safety guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/12902428-use-claude-in-chrome-safely) adds that it may not bypass CAPTCHAs. The same guide says you remain responsible for what Claude does in your browser, including a site’s terms on automated access. The browser suits one form you watch. A connected service suits a steady flow of applications.


## Directory connectors vs custom connectors


A connector links Claude to an outside service over the Model Context Protocol (MCP), so Claude can read data there and act for you. A job search uses two kinds.


Directory connector Custom connector


Where you find it Customize, then Connectors, then **+** or **Discover** . On the web,[claude.com/connectors](https://claude.com/connectors) lists nearly 1,200 You paste the service’s remote MCP server address


Who checked it Each listing names its maker and carries a Verified or Community label Anthropic says custom connectors reach services it has not verified


Plans All plans. On Team and Enterprise, an Owner enables it first Free (one), Pro, Max, Ultra, Team and Enterprise. On Team and Enterprise, an Owner adds it


Job-search examples Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive, Notion, Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter, Snagajob Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify, LoopCV, JobSeek


[Anthropic’s custom connector guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp) says Claude reaches a custom connector from Anthropic’s cloud, not from your computer, so the server must be public over HTTPS. Every service in this ranking is hosted, so each one works in Claude on the web, on desktop and on mobile.


## How to add a connector in Claude


These are Anthropic’s steps as of November 20, 2026.[Claude Docs](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/getting-started) give the same Customize, then Connectors path on claude.ai and in the desktop app.


### Add a connector from the directory


1. Open **Customize** , then **Connectors** . In the desktop app, select **Customize** in the sidebar first.
2. Select **+** next to Connectors, or **Discover** , and search for the service.
3. Select **Connect** , sign in to the service and approve the access Claude asks for.
4. In a chat, open **+** (or type **/** ), then **Connectors** , and turn the connector on.


### Add a custom connector


1. Open **Customize** , then **Connectors** .
2. Select **+ Add** , then **Add custom connector** . Some accounts show **Add** , then **Custom** , then **Web** .
3. Enter a name and the remote MCP server address exactly as the provider documents it, then select **Continue** .
4. Review the sign-in settings, such as **Sign in now** and **Register automatically** .[Claude Docs](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/custom/add-unlisted) say to keep options marked **Detected** unless the server’s documentation says otherwise.
5. Select **Add** , then **Connect** , and sign in to the service.


On Team and Enterprise, an Owner or Primary Owner enables a directory connector or adds a custom one under **Organization settings** , then **Connectors** , and members then connect their own accounts, per[Anthropic’s connectors guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11176164-use-connectors-to-extend-claude-s-capabilities) . Adding connectors on mobile is in beta, so use the web or desktop app. Connectors you add in claude.ai also work in Claude Code when you sign in with the same account, per[Claude Docs](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/getting-started) .


### Control what each connector can do


Open a connector under **Customize** , then **Connectors** , and set each tool or group of tools to **Always allow** , **Needs approval** or **Blocked** , per[Claude Docs](https://claude.com/docs/connectors/getting-started) . Some accounts also show **Always ask** on the connector’s **Permissions** tab.


**Needs approval** does not always mean Claude asks.[Anthropic’s permission table](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork#h_c274f6c9b5) says that in Auto mode, which it is rolling out as the default on Pro, Max, Ultra and Team, such a tool runs without asking unless an automated check flags it as risky.[Always ask](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/13345190-get-started-with-claude-cowork#h_b24dec5b5a) , still rolling out, makes Claude ask before each use in every mode, and **Manual** mode asks before every **Needs approval** tool.


For a job search, set every tool that submits an application, approves a résumé or sends an email to **Always ask** if you see it, or keep the chat in **Manual** mode.[Research can call connector tools without further approval](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11175166-get-started-with-custom-connectors-using-remote-mcp) , so turn those tools off before you use it.

## 1. Tsenta: find, tailor, apply and track from Claude


Tsenta’s MCP server gives Claude the tools in your Tsenta account. Claude can get roles ranked against your profile, filtered by location, pay, remote work and date posted, and read a job link you paste. Tsenta watches 300,000+ company career pages for those matches. Ask Claude to apply to one role, a batch or a pasted link, and Tsenta submits each application in the cloud on supported company career sites. It tailors your résumé for each role in Honest or Aggressive mode, or sends it as written, and drafts a cover letter when the form takes one.


Claude can also manage your tracker, including roles you applied to elsewhere, and read recruiter emails in your dedicated Tsenta inbox and reply from your Tsenta address. Its networking tools find a contact and a verified work email and save a draft; Tsenta never sends outreach for you. It cannot read your personal Gmail or Outlook; Claude’s Gmail connector is a separate connector.


Claude sends each apply request to Tsenta’s queue, so check its status before you count it as sent. With résumé auto-approval off, each tailored résumé waits for approval, which Claude can give through Tsenta’s approve tool, and form review pauses before the final submit on employer systems that support it. Ask Claude to show you each résumé and form first, and set the approve and apply tools to **Always ask** , or keep the chat in **Manual** mode. One sign-in gives Claude every available Tsenta tool, including ones that edit your profile, move tracker entries and reply to email.


Connecting is free on every Tsenta plan. Only submitted applications count against your allowance; failed, skipped or cancelled attempts are returned. Your first 25 applications are free, once per account, with no card. In USD global pricing, Starter is $19 a month for 600 applications, Pro $39 for 1,500 and Power $99 for 4,500 per 30-day cycle. Auto Apply, which submits eligible roles within your filters without per-role approval, needs Power; on Starter and Pro you choose each role and Tsenta submits it. See[pricing](https://tsenta.com/pricing) for quarterly billing.


Where others win: JobGPT’s connector sends recruiter outreach email for you. Simplify’s guide says its assistant will never submit an application without asking you first, while Tsenta leaves that to Claude’s tool permissions. LoopCV has a free plan with no time limit. The directory connectors in this list connect from Claude’s own directory with no server address to paste, and each carries the Anthropic verified badge.


### Add Tsenta as a Claude connector


1. Sign up for Tsenta and fill in your profile in the dashboard. Set your address and location there, since Claude cannot set them.
2. Follow the custom connector steps above: name it Tsenta, paste` https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp` , choose **Sign in now** and **Register automatically** if asked, leave request headers, client ID and secret empty, select **Add** , then **Connect** , sign in to Tsenta and select **Approve** .
3. In a chat, open **+** , then **Connectors** , and turn Tsenta on. Start with “Find backend engineer roles in New York posted in the last 24 hours.” Then try “Apply to the top match, and let me review the tailored résumé first.”


In Claude Code, add it with one command, then run` /mcp` , pick Tsenta and choose **Authenticate** :


```text
claude mcp add --transport http tsenta https://api.autojobs.me/api/v1/mcp


```


The[Help Center guide](https://help.tsenta.com/connect-claude-chatgpt-mcp) covers Team and Enterprise setup, privacy, disconnecting and troubleshooting, and[tsenta.com/mcp](https://tsenta.com/mcp) has the steps for every assistant Tsenta documents.


## 2. JobGPT: a custom connector that applies and emails recruiters


[6figr’s JobGPT MCP server](https://github.com/6figr-com/jobgpt-mcp-server) lists 34 tools. They include job search with filters for salary and H1B sponsorship, job hunts with auto-apply settings,` generate_resume_for_job` ,` calculate_match_score` ,` apply_to_job` and` send_outreach` , which sends an email to a recruiter or referrer. For Claude, its README uses browser sign-in: add a custom connector named JobGPT with` https://mcp.6figr.com/mcp` , select **Connect** and approve on 6figr.


[6figr’s auto-apply page](https://6figr.com/auto-apply) says you can apply to 5 jobs free, then each job costs one credit. As of November 20, 2026 it lists Casual Hunter at $34.99 a month for 100 auto applies, Active Hunter at $64.99 for 200 and Apex Predator at $95.99 for 400. It says JobGPT applies to 10 to 20 jobs a day and that you get a confirmation email from the company’s site when an application succeeds.


Where it wins: it sends outreach email itself, and its tool list is public. Its README does not say on which employer systems` apply_to_job` can complete a form.


## 3. Simplify: Autopilot applications from a Claude chat


Simplify published[its Claude, ChatGPT and Codex guide](https://help.simplify.jobs/articles/8107058-use-simplify-in-claude-chatgpt-and-codex-mcp) on November 20, 2026. You add` https://mcp.simplify.jobs/mcp` as a custom connector, keep the default settings and sign in to Simplify. At sign-in, checking **Apply and update your profile** lets Claude save jobs, update your Job Tracker, create tailored résumé copies, change Autopilot settings and submit Autopilot applications.


Simplify says Autopilot submits supported applications without a final review step, so in a chat the assistant confirms the job, the résumé and your tailoring settings, then submits only after you say yes.


You need an active Simplify+ subscription: free Simplify accounts can sign in but cannot connect.[Simplify’s pricing article](https://help.simplify.jobs/articles/5623502-whats-included-in-simplify-features-and-pricing) lists $19.99 a week, $39.99 a month or $89.99 for three months on the web as of November 20, 2026.[Its credits article](https://help.simplify.jobs/articles/4455305-autopilot-credits-and-failed-applications) says Simplify+ includes 100 Autopilot credits a week, used only when an application is submitted successfully. Simplify notes that Claude does not yet show the tailored résumé PDF in the chat.


Where it wins: Simplify’s own guide says the assistant asks for your yes before every Autopilot submission, a step Tsenta leaves to Claude’s tool permissions.


## 4. LoopCV: apply with Claude through LoopCV


[LoopCV’s apply-with-Claude page](https://www.loopcv.pro/apply-with-claude/) says Claude can search jobs, filter the best matches and submit applications through LoopCV, which adjusts your CV and cover letter for each posting.


LoopCV’s two setup pages disagree. The landing page describes an API key and a Claude menu, Settings, then Integrations, that no longer exists.[LoopCV’s step-by-step guide](https://blog.loopcv.pro/how-to-connect-loopcv-to-claude-via-mcp/) says to email LoopCV support first so they turn on MCP for your account. Then you add` https://api.loopcv.com/mcp` as a custom connector, enter the OAuth client ID and secret LoopCV publishes under Advanced settings, and sign in with your LoopCV email and password. Follow the guide.


Where it wins: a free plan with no card and no time limit. As of November 20, 2026,[LoopCV’s own comparison page](https://www.loopcv.pro/sonara-alternative/) lists that free plan with up to 10 applications or recruiter emails a month and paid plans from $19.99 a month for up to 100, while[its pricing page](https://www.loopcv.pro/pricing/) says paid plans start from €9.99 a month. Check the total at checkout. Its pages do not say on which employer systems it can submit.


## 5. JobSeek: scores and form data, you submit


[JobSeek’s MCP page](https://www.getjobseek.com/mcp) lists tools that score a job from 0 to 100 with an apply, consider or skip call, return “profile data formatted for application forms”, suggest résumé changes for applicant tracking systems, open searches across major job boards and track application status. It does not submit by itself. JobSeek says to pair it with Claude in Chrome to do the typing, and that nothing is submitted without your say-so.


Setup puts your JobSeek key in the server address, so treat that address like a password. Its claude.ai path (Settings, then Integrations) is out of date, so use the custom connector steps above. No price is published, and its buttons read “Get started free”.


Where it wins: a quick fit score on any listing you paste. The typing step needs Claude in Chrome on a paid Claude plan, with the browser limits above.


## 6. Gmail: recruiter email in the chat


[Gmail’s connector](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/gmail) is made by Google, was added in March 2026 and lists 29 tools.[Anthropic’s Google Workspace guide](https://support.claude.com/en/articles/10166901-use-google-workspace-connectors) says Claude can search and read email, draft, and send, reply to and forward messages, asking for your approval before each send outside Auto mode. In Auto mode, Anthropic says these actions can run without asking unless an automated check flags them as risky, and that the check can miss risky actions.


In a job search, ask Claude to find every recruiter thread from the last two weeks, summarize where each stands and draft follow-ups for you to send. It can also label job mail and create filters. Anthropic says it does not train its models on your Gmail, Drive or Calendar connector data.


## 7. Google Calendar: interviews and prep time


[Google Calendar’s connector](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/google-calendar) is made by Google and has nine tools, including` search_events` ,` suggest_time` ,` create_event` and` respond_to_event` . Ask Claude to find two free hours for a take-home assignment, accept an interview invitation or list every interview next week with the company and the role. It asks before acting, like Gmail, outside Auto mode.


## 8. Notion: a job tracker Claude can update


[Notion’s connector](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/notion) is made by Notion and lists 69 tools. It can search your workspace, create and update pages, create tasks, update statuses and add notes to databases. Start from one of Notion’s[job application tracking templates](https://www.notion.com/templates/category/job-application-tracking) , then ask Claude to add each new application as a row and move it to Interviewing when a recruiter replies.[Notion’s pricing page](https://www.notion.com/pricing) lists a Free plan at $0.


It does not apply to jobs. If an applying service already keeps your tracker, as Tsenta does, Notion is a second copy you maintain.


## 9. Google Drive: résumés, cover letters and spreadsheets


[Google Drive’s connector](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/google-drive) is made by Google and has 11 tools. Claude can search and read Docs, Sheets, Slides and PDFs, upload files, and share, move or trash them, asking first outside Auto mode. Use it to find the résumé version you sent to a company, read a spreadsheet of past applications or save a cover letter Claude drafted. Anthropic’s guide adds that separate Google Docs, Sheets and Slides connectors let Claude edit those files live in a pane beside the chat, on the web in Chrome or in Claude Desktop with the built-in browser on.


## 10. Indeed: Indeed listings inside Claude


[Indeed’s connector](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/indeed) was added in November 2025 and needs an Indeed sign-in. Anthropic’s listing shows two tools,` search_jobs` and` get_job_details` .[Indeed’s own docs](https://docs.indeed.com/mcp/) say the server is in beta and can also read the experience on your Indeed profile and look up company data. Anthropic’s listing says it provides direct job links, and neither of its two tools submits an application.


## 11. Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob: more listings, no sign-in


Three more job-board connectors need no sign-in, and each lists a` search_jobs` tool.[Dice](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/dice) searches tech jobs.[ZipRecruiter](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/ziprecruiter) filters by salary, distance, remote or hybrid work, employment type and date posted, then says to “jump to ZipRecruiter to apply”.[Snagajob](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/snagajob) , made by JobGet, covers hourly and part-time work and sends you to Snagajob to apply.


The one directory listing we found that acts for you is[Upwork](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/upwork) , and it submits freelance proposals, not job applications.


## Is there a Claude connector for LinkedIn job search?


No. On November 20, 2026, the only LinkedIn listing in Claude’s directory was[LinkedIn Hiring Pro](https://claude.com/marketplace/connectors/linkedin-hiring-pro) . It lets eligible LinkedIn members draft and post one free job from Claude, and its listing says it does not manage applicants. The directory also lists several connectors for applicant tracking systems, and those serve employers, not candidates.


For listings inside Claude, use Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter or Snagajob. To have an application sent, add one of the four custom connectors that submit.


## A Claude job search setup that keeps you in control


1. Connect Gmail and Google Calendar from the directory, plus Notion or Google Drive if that is where your tracker lives.
2. Add one service that applies as a custom connector, and set its apply, approve and send tools to **Always ask** , or keep the chat in **Manual** mode.
3. Start read-only: “Show three matching roles and explain why each fits.”
4. Apply to one role you picked, with résumé review on, and read the tailored résumé before you approve it.
5. Check the application’s status rather than treating a chat reply as proof it was sent.
6. Ask Claude to draft a follow-up in Gmail and put the interview on your calendar. Send the email yourself.


For more on each step, read our guides to[how AI agents apply to jobs](https://tsenta.com/blog/how-ai-agents-apply-to-jobs-2026) ,[tailoring your résumé through an assistant](https://tsenta.com/blog/ai-assistant-connectors-tailor-resume-2026) and[tracking applications with AI assistants](https://tsenta.com/blog/track-job-applications-ai-assistants-2026) .

Tsenta publishes step-by-step setup for Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and Codex. In ChatGPT it connects as a ChatGPT app, which OpenAI now calls a plugin, with plan limits our[ChatGPT apps ranking](https://tsenta.com/blog/best-chatgpt-apps-job-search-2026) explains. For the longer walkthrough, see our[guide to connecting a job search agent to Claude or ChatGPT](https://tsenta.com/blog/connect-ai-job-search-agent-to-claude-chatgpt-2026) .


## Frequently asked questions


### What are the best Claude connectors for job search?


The best Claude connectors for job search are Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify and LoopCV if you want Claude to apply for you, and Gmail, Google Calendar, Notion and Google Drive for the email, interviews and tracking around each application. The four that apply are custom connectors you add by their server address. Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob are in Anthropic’s directory, but they search listings and link out, so you apply yourself.


### Is there a Claude connector that applies to jobs for me?


Yes, Tsenta’s MCP server works as a Claude connector that applies to jobs for you, and JobGPT, Simplify and LoopCV document the same. None of them is in Anthropic’s connector directory, so you add each one under Customize, then Connectors, as a custom connector with its server address, then sign in. Simplify needs a Simplify+ subscription, and LoopCV asks you to email its support to turn on MCP first. Tsenta submits on supported company career sites, and your first 25 applications are free with no card.


### What are the best Claude connectors in 2026?


For a job search, the best Claude connectors in 2026 are Gmail, Google Calendar, Google Drive and Notion from Anthropic’s directory, plus one custom connector that applies, such as Tsenta. Google makes the Gmail, Calendar and Drive connectors, Notion makes its own, and all four carry the Anthropic verified badge. The directory listed nearly 1,200 connectors on November 20, 2026, so start with the ones that hold your email, calendar and tracker.


### Where is the list of Claude connectors for 2026?


Anthropic’s list of Claude connectors is the Connectors directory. Open it in Claude under Customize, then Connectors, or on the web at claude.com/connectors, which now opens the Claude Marketplace page for connectors and plugins. It showed nearly 1,200 connectors on November 20, 2026, and each listing names its maker, its tools and whether it needs sign-in. The job-seeker listings we found were Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob, and none of them submits applications.


### Can I use a Claude connector to apply to jobs?


Yes, if the connector reaches a service that submits applications. Add Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify or LoopCV as a custom connector, sign in, then ask Claude to apply to a role you chose. Set the connector’s apply tools to Always ask in its tool permissions if you see that option, or keep the chat in Manual mode, so Claude asks you before each one. In Tsenta, Auto Apply, which submits eligible roles without per-role approval, needs Power, and on Starter and Pro you choose each role and Tsenta submits it.


### Is there a Claude connector for LinkedIn job search?


No, Claude’s directory had no LinkedIn connector for job seekers on November 20, 2026. LinkedIn’s listing, LinkedIn Hiring Pro, lets eligible members draft and post one free job from Claude, and it does not manage applicants. For job listings inside Claude, the directory has Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob.


### Which Anthropic Claude connectors and integrations help with job search and applications?


Anthropic’s directory covers the work around an application: Gmail for recruiter email, Google Calendar for interviews, Google Drive and Notion for résumés and trackers, and Indeed, Dice, ZipRecruiter and Snagajob for listings. The application itself needs a third-party custom connector such as Tsenta, JobGPT, Simplify or LoopCV, or Claude in Chrome on a paid plan for a form you watch. Claude in Chrome is not allowed to create accounts or get past CAPTCHAs, which some application sites require.
